items.title: Lou Pallo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: Les didn’t feel good and I called Bucky and Jerry came in and we got together. He was very nice, a very nice man.

ctx.x: There’s a nice picture here off of your website with Jerry Seinfeld.

Oh that was at the Iridium. He showed up one night. And Bucky was on that night in fact. Les didn’t feel good and I called Bucky and Jerry came in and we got together. He was very nice, a very nice man.
Neat. Who were some of the — is there anybody that you haven’t worked with that you’d like to?
